claims.text: The owner decided the question the last article left open: the meter charges for what is read, not for what is scrolled.
claims.quote: Charge based on what you read, not based on what you scroll.

claims.text: A page flicked to the end now costs the minimum, a tenth of its price; a page read through costs its price; a reset refunds to the minimum.
claims.quote: A page flicked to the end costs the minimum, a tenth of its price; a page read through costs its price

claims.text: Read is the measure the reading strip already kept: time on each section while the tab is in front and the reader active, against the section's words at 300 a minute.
claims.quote: against the section's words at 300 a minute

claims.text: Reading done on an earlier visit is not charged again; a return visit is charged only for what is read beyond it.
claims.quote: charged only for what is read beyond yesterday

claims.text: The meter's block on a return visit showed 1p charged and 0 percent read this visit, with 58 percent read before and not charged again.
claims.quote: 0% read this visit (58% read before, not charged again)

value.unit: percent read on an earlier visit

claims.text: The owner's brief was that the user is in control: if the measure says a section was read and the reader disagrees, they can say so.
claims.quote: The owner's words were the brief: "the user is in control".

claims.text: Pause stops all measuring, and so all charging, on every page until the reader resumes, and it is kept in the browser so a reload or another article stays paused.
claims.quote: It is kept in the browser, so a reload or another article stays paused.

claims.text: Reset sets every section of a page back to unread and refunds the page to its minimum; reading it again is charged again.
claims.quote: Every section goes back to unread, and the meter refunds the page to its minimum; reading it again is charged again.

claims.text: Any section can be marked read or unread by hand: marked read it is charged as read, marked unread it goes back to zero, and the map says which were marked.
claims.quote: A section marked read counts as read, and is charged as read; a section marked unread goes back to zero.

claims.text: The owner described hiding what was read, showing a line or a small paragraph; the agent built those three and three more, six views in all, so they can be compared.
claims.quote: I built those three, and three more around them, so they can be compared

claims.text: Margin is the default view: a line beside a read section, solid when read, pale when part read, grey when only scrolled past, so nothing on the page moves.
claims.quote: a line beside it: solid when read, pale when part read, grey when only scrolled past

claims.text: The owner was precise that nothing should change while the reader is reading, so they can read at their own pace.
claims.quote: you want to allow the user to read at the pace that the user is reading

claims.text: The views switch on in two cases only: the reader comes back to an article partly read before, or scrolls back up by more than half a window after going down at least a window.
claims.quote: So the views switch on in two cases only: the reader comes back to an article they had read some of before, or they scroll back up by more than half a window after going down at least a window.

claims.text: A section on screen is never folded or unfolded by the clock; it changes when off screen or when the reader asks.
claims.quote: A section on screen is never folded or unfolded by the clock; it changes when it is off screen, or when the reader asks.

claims.text: When a fold changes the height of the page above what the reader is looking at, the scroll position is corrected so the words in view do not move.
claims.quote: the scroll position is corrected so the words in view do not move

claims.text: Every section of every article now has a line and a paragraph: 1,897 sections in 174 articles, each with about eight words and two or three sentences saying what it says.
claims.quote: 1,897 sections in 174 articles, each with about eight words and two or three sentences that say what it says

claims.text: Fourteen agents wrote the summaries: twelve in parallel taking about fourteen articles each, then two for the twelve articles published while they worked.
claims.quote: Twelve agents each took about fourteen articles, and two more took the twelve articles other sessions published while they worked.

claims.text: Each agent wrote a line of six to nine words saying what the section says, not what it is about, and a paragraph of 30 to 60 words with its figures, names and conclusion.
claims.quote: a line of six to nine words saying what the section says, not what it is about, and a paragraph of 30 to 60 words with its figures, names and conclusion

claims.text: A script checked every summary for length, the wording rules and that every section of the article had both a line and a paragraph.
claims.quote: A script checked every one for the length, the wording rules

claims.text: Several agents reported articles that disagree with themselves, a count in the opening differing from the same count later; the summaries follow each section's own figure and those articles are for the writer to correct.
claims.quote: Several agents reported where an article disagrees with itself, a count in its opening that differs from the same count later

claims.text: Summaries are now part of writing an article, beside the graph; a section without one gets an extract, and the build counts the extracts so they do not stay.
claims.quote: A section without one gets an extract, its first sentence, and the build counts the extracts so they do not stay.

claims.text: None of this is carried to the vault yet; the reading records, the pause and the chosen view are kept in the browser only, like the theme.
claims.quote: The reading records, the pause and the chosen view are kept in this browser only, like the theme.

claims.text: The meter does not know what the reader understood; read is still time in view while present, and the controls exist because the measure can be wrong in both directions.
claims.quote: Read is still time in view while you were present.

claims.text: It summarises sections, not paragraphs, because sections are what is measured.
claims.quote: sections are what is measured, so they came first

claims.text: The views are text; the owner's next step, a picture in place of a folded section, is not built.
claims.quote: a picture in place of a folded section, is not built

claims.text: Rereading after a reset is charged again, as decided; it is one line to change.
claims.quote: After a reset, reading a page again costs what reading it costs.

claims.text: The meter's v1.5.0 core gains settle(share), which sets the share of the price charged in steps of 5 percent, never below the tenth for opening.
claims.quote: which sets the share of the price charged, up or down, in steps of 5%, never below the tenth for opening

claims.text: The page view no longer listens to scrolling; it reads the reading record when the page opens and settles on every reading event to what was read beyond the base.
claims.quote: The page view no longer listens to scrolling.

claims.text: Each written summary carries the first twelve characters of the SHA-256 of its section's text, and when they no longer match the summary is served marked stale.
claims.quote: Each written summary carries the first twelve characters of the SHA-256 of its section's text; when they no longer match, the summary is served marked stale.

claims.text: The gate is a browser test with Playwright's clock, so a minute of reading takes milliseconds, covering pause, mark, reset, the six views and the charges.
claims.quote: with Playwright's clock so a minute of reading takes milliseconds

claims.text: The owner's message of 17 October 2026 is the brief and the editorial responsibility is his; the code, screenshots and measurements are the agent's.
claims.quote: The code, the screenshots and the measurements are mine

entities.role: the reading meter, now v1.5.0, charging by what is read
the owner whose message decided the billing and briefed the controls and views
the site whose 174 articles and 1,897 sections now carry summaries
the agent that built the release and wrote the article
the hash that marks a summary stale when its section changes
its clock drives the browser test that gates the release

dates.what: The owner's decision to charge for what is read; the meter's v1.5.0, the controls, the six views and the 1,897 summaries ship
